## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test` all pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and fail without it
- [ ] `npm run changeset` if this changes published behaviour ([why](../CONTRIBUTING.md#-versioning--releases))
